mapper.insert: insert into qt_material_file_cleanup (material_id, file_path, status, attempt_count, create_by, create_time) values (#{materialId}, #{filePath}, 'PENDING', 0, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select cleanup_id, material_id, file_path, status, attempt_count, last_error, create_by from qt_material_file_cleanup where status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED') and attempt_count < 5 order by cleanup_id asc limit 50
mapper.update: update qt_material_file_cleanup set status = #{status}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where cleanup_id = #{cleanupId}
